data.name: Faizan
data.gender_notes: Faizan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ف-ي-ض (f-y-ḍ), 'to overflow, abound'. Fayḍān means 'grace, bounty'. Its root is ف-ي-ض (f-y-ḍ). A common South Asian Muslim name. Faizan is a Arabic name meaning “Grace; bounty; abundance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Faizan expresses “Grace; bounty; abundance”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ف-ي-ض (f-y-ḍ), 'to overflow, abound'. Fayḍān means 'grace, bounty'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faizan total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
